sentences.text: The James Bond series focuses on a fictional British Secret Service agent created in 1953 by writer Ian Fleming , who featured him in twelve novels and two short-story collections .	Ian Fleming	Ian Fleming	British Secret Service	Secret Intelligence Service	series	James Bond in film

Since Fleming 's death in 1964 , eight other authors have written authorised Bond novels or novelizations : Kingsley Amis , Christopher Wood , John Gardner , Raymond Benson , Sebastian Faulks , Jeffery Deaver , William Boyd and Anthony Horowitz .	Kingsley Amis	Kingsley Amis	Christopher Wood	Christopher Wood (writer)	John Gardner	John Gardner (British writer)	Raymond Benson	Raymond Benson	Sebastian Faulks	Sebastian Faulks	Jeffery Deaver	Jeffery Deaver	William Boyd	William Boyd (writer)	Anthony Horowitz	Anthony Horowitz
The latest novel is Trigger Mortis by Anthony Horowitz , published in September 2015 .	Anthony Horowitz	Anthony Horowitz	Trigger Mortis	Trigger Mortis

Additionally Charlie Higson wrote a series on a young James Bond , and Kate Westbrook wrote three novels based on the diaries of a recurring series character , Moneypenny .	Charlie Higson	Charlie Higson	a young James Bond	Young Bond	Kate Westbrook	Samantha Weinberg	diaries of a recurring series character	The Moneypenny Diaries	Moneypenny	Miss Moneypenny	series	James Bond in film
The character has also been adapted for television , radio , comic strip , video games and film .

The films are the longest continually running film series of all time and have grossed over $ 7.040 billion in total , making it the fourth-highest-grossing film series to date , which started in 1962 with Dr. No , starring Sean Connery as Bond .	Sean Connery	Sean Connery	fourth-highest-grossing film series	List of highest-grossing films#Highest-grossing franchises and film series	Dr. No	Dr. No (film)	series	James Bond in film
As of , there have been twenty-four films in the Eon Productions series .	Eon Productions	Eon Productions	series	James Bond in film

The most recent Bond film , Spectre -LRB- 2015 -RRB- , stars Daniel Craig in his fourth portrayal of Bond ; he is the sixth actor to play Bond in the Eon series .	Daniel Craig	Daniel Craig	series	James Bond in film	Spectre	Spectre (2015 film)

There have also been two independent productions of Bond films : Casino Royale -LRB- a 1967 spoof -RRB- and Never Say Never Again -LRB- a 1983 remake of an earlier Eon-produced film , Thunderball -RRB- .	Casino Royale	Casino Royale (1967 film)	spoof	Parody	Never Say Never Again	Never Say Never Again	Thunderball	Thunderball (film)

In 2015 , the franchise was estimated to be worth $ 19.9 billion , making James Bond one of the highest-grossing media franchises of all time .	highest-grossing media franchises of all time	List of the highest-grossing media franchises

The Bond films are renowned for a number of features , including the musical accompaniment , with the theme songs having received Academy Award nominations on several occasions , and two wins .	Academy Award	Academy Award
Other important elements which run through most of the films include Bond 's cars , his guns , and the gadgets with which he is supplied by Q Branch .	Q Branch	Q (James Bond)
The films are also noted for Bond 's relationships with various women , who are sometimes referred to as `` Bond girls '' .	Bond girls	Bond girls
